Name: Pelican Town Wholesale
Author: blue704
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/236691548-1776697695.png[/img][/center]
Just as you enter Pelican Town, there is now a small stand waiting for you on Spring 14. Your first  customer is Gus and he will ask you to supply him with a seasonal crop. 

After completion of your first order, the whole town will begin placing orders with you. Gus will still ask for all sorts of things including vegetables, fruit, and alcohol. Or maybe Willy needs some fishing bait? Plenty of NPCs will post their own unique orders here so that you can make your farm even more profitable!

Hopefully this gives you another way to support the Town and maybe add a few new goals to slower parts of the game such as the Winter season. Depending on what other mods you have installed you can expect different orders as well. As of now it supports [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url][color=#efefef], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia - More Crops, [/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27049]Wildflour Atelier Goods[/url][/color][color=#efefef] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40013]Joja Machines[color=#efefef].[/color][/url][/color]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/236691548-1776697726.png[/img][/center]
Some of the orders you can expect:
Gus will ask for a variety of goods ranging from vinegar, fish, crops, and alcohol.
Marnie is in desperate need of Hay.
The Wizard is looking for Monster Parts.
Andy wants to try out some fertilizer.
Morris needs Joja Products to fill the shelves of JojaMart.
Clint needs some extra crafting bars.
Gunther is looking for fossils and minerals.
And more!

[left][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/236691548-1778085609.png[/img][/left]
[left][/left]
[left]Now you can also help the town out with festival preparation. Lewis will visit your house throughout the year and ask for help for two festivals each month. [/left]
[left][/left]
[left]Think you can gather 100 eggs in seven days? Go for it and Lewis may have an extra special surprise for you. But don't worry if you're just getting started on the farm either, because the majority of these orders have different choices for the player depending on how confident you are. Rewards are mostly monetary, but some of the larger orders grant special items as well as friendship bonuses for the villagers.[/left]
[left][/left]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/236691548-1778085656.png[/img]

If you happen to have ideas for some orders you'd like to see please let me know. Or if there are other expansions you would like to be supported don’t be afraid to ask. 

Mod is also now configurable through GMCM if you would like to use the old version of the stand you can disable the new option.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/236691548-1770578044.png[/img]
[color=#ffff00][b]I just updated from an older version and now all of the orders are gone?[/b][/color]
[color=#efefef]As part of this new version I made it so that the board doesn't show up until Spring 14 and requires you to do an intro quest (Gus' Order) before unlocking the full board. If you updated from an older version the new event should play as soon as you enter Pelican Town after Spring 14 and you will have the new journal quest from Gus. After completing the quest, the board should function as before.[/color]
[color=#ffff00][b]There is a bush blocking the orders board?[/b][/color]
[color=#efefef]This will happen if you add the mod to an existing save. You can destroy the bush with an upgraded axe or there is a mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6304]Destroyable Bushes[/url] that will allow you to destroy it with an axe. Once it's gone it will not come back.[/color]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/236691548-1765906172.png[/img]
[color=#ffff00]Config Options:[color=#d8d8d8] Added new GMCM options in version 1.1.1 where you can disable festival orders and regular orders individually if you happen to only prefer one of them. [/color][/color]

[color=#ffff00][color=#d8d8d8]As of version 1.1.4,  there are many new options for WAG.  If a Pelican Town Wholesale option is selected true it MUST be selected true in WAG's options as well. You can have the items true in WAG but false for Pelican Town Wholesale if you like. All options default to false. If you encounter any error items, be sure to check both mods config options to ensure compatibility.[/color][/color]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15100]Seven Deadly Sins:[color=#efefef] [/color][/url] [color=#efefef]Added a GMCM option for SDS compatibility that moves the order board further down and to the left. If you select the compatibility option on an existing save there will be bushes that you will have to remove. [/color]

[color=#ffff00]Translations: [/color][color=#e69138][color=#d8d8d8][i]Chinese. [/i]Thanks again [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/dark8807]dark8807[/url]! Go [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45915]here[/url] to download the zh.json an then add to the mods i18n folder.[/color][/color]

[color=#efefef]Also feel free to check out my other mods:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40013]Joja Machines: [/url]Adds new Joja themed machines and products as well as a little bit more of a story for Morris.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44722]Joja Civic Center:[/url] If you would like to try out the Joja route  but don't want to miss out on bundles this mod adds a whole new building full of bundles as part of the Joja storyline.[/color]
